description:
List the NBS codes NFS-e Anexo VIII pairs with a service code.

Suggestions, not a decision: show them to the user and put an nbs
on the item only after they pick one. Each carries the cIndOp and
cClassTrib Anexo VIII lists for it, which belong in the item's
ibs_cbs group only when the user also confirms them. Empty when
the annex lists none.

service_code.description: The LC 116 item.subitem as items[].service_code takes it: 1.07, 01.07.00 or 010700.

name: suggest_nbs

NbsCandidate.description: One NBS the NFS-e Anexo VIII lists for a service code.

incidence.description: Where Anexo VIII says the IBS is due.

operation_variants.description: cIndOp when not onerous or the acquirer is abroad: onerous_domestic, onerous_abroad, free_domestic, free_abroad.

outputSchema.description: What Anexo VIII lists for a service code; empty when it lists none.

confirmation_required.description: Always true: confirm the nbs with the user.
